svg.text: Target architecture, single EKS cluster hosting dev / staging / prod namespaces. Dashed = prod-only. Dev exists only during work sessions (make up / make destroy).
Network Load Balancer (AWS LB Controller), one node per AZ → Istio Ingress Gateway pods
Interface endpoints: ECR api · ECR dkr · STS
prod only (billed per endpoint per AZ)
GitHub OIDC roles · EKS Pod Identity
• Ephemeral by design: make up / make destroy per session, a nightly scheduled destroy as a safety net, Budgets alerts. ~$0.30–0.50/hr while up.
• Dev keeps one NAT gateway, single-AZ RDS, one Redis node and no interface endpoints; prod adds the dashed parts.
• Graviton (arm64) nodes, Spot via Karpenter for workloads; one on-demand node keeps platform add-ons stable.
• App subnets are /20 because the VPC CNI gives every pod a VPC IP address.
• RDS and Redis are AWS-managed, not pods in EKS. They sit in private data subnets; security groups allow only EKS nodes/pods.
• No static credentials: CI assumes IAM roles via GitHub OIDC; pods use EKS Pod Identity.
